metadata.title: State-transfer interventions in adaptive decision-tree populations under concept drift: companion software and evidence
metadata.resource_type_basis: Continuity with the existing companion software-and-evidence series; mixed data contents explained explicitly.
description_paragraphs_en_GB: Version 1.5.0 of the companion software and selected evidence for studies of state-transfer interventions in adaptive decision-tree populations under concept drift. It distinguishes the unchanged historical version 1.0.0 record from subsequently recovered source files and separately scoped saved-evidence objects. It is a source-availability and evidence-curation update, not certification of complete historical campaign reproduction.

The source package includes recovered primary-core and test-module source files and declared F10 import-path corrections. The recorded static closure covers 221 literal relative JavaScript-import edges, and the same 79 JavaScript files retain their recorded syntax-only acceptance. These checks do not establish project import, test success or native runtime qualification. The exact original I05 protocol is held privately; the source package contains a distinct metadata-redacted derivative, which is not substituted at native original-lock bindings. Historical chronology and the complete authenticated configuration remain unqualified.

Selected evidence includes the separately identified AB1 implementation of existing-record resource reanalysis, the finite DEV qualification ledger including adverse outcomes, and the MT1 saved-result chain. AB1 is not a bitwise historical implementation reproduction or a new confirmatory predictive family: its saved shared 18-contrast family leaves the three APW directions unresolved and establishes no simultaneous five- or six-coordinate dominance. MT1 retains its original owner STOP with MT1_NATURAL_APW_REPORT. Its subsequent supplementary saved-data audit, including the legacy CPU-field schema exception, and prespecified descriptive extraction have separate scopes. Missing CPU fields have not been filled or interpreted as measured zero; no new independent replicate or native-owner PASS is asserted.

The evidence package distinguishes byte-exact existing records and four frozen synthetic tapes from twelve labelled metadata-reduced JSON views. The views preserve retained scientific values and source identities while omitting declared operational metadata; they do not replace original native closeouts or receipts. CT3 has only an explicitly derived administrative adverse-outcome summary. The saved AB1 coordinates underlying Supplementary Figures S7-S9 are retained as FIGURE_6_COORDINATES.csv, FIGURE_7_COORDINATES.csv and FIGURE_8_COORDINATES.csv. Manuscripts, publisher-facing figure graphics, editable drawings and raw private operational archives are excluded from these source-and-evidence packages.

Licences are assigned per file: original software uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; original documentation, protocols, metadata and selected evidence use Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International, subject to preserved file-specific exceptions, legal-text terms and third-party notices. This is not a blanket CC-BY, MIT or OSI-open-source grant. Consult LICENSE-POLICY.md, LICENCE_PROPOSALS.json, licensing/licence-map.json where present, and the exact file manifests. The external release manifest and SHA256SUMS.txt identify the deposited archive bytes.
